title: Training, validation and test sets
text: Training data fits model parameters. Validation data selects hyperparameters. The test set estimates performance after model selection and should not guide tuning.

title: Data leakage
text: Data leakage occurs when information unavailable at prediction time enters training. Fit preprocessing transformations only on training data, then apply the fitted transformation to validation and test data.

title: Precision
text: Precision is true positives divided by all predicted positives. It measures how many positive predictions are correct.

title: Recall
text: Recall is true positives divided by all actual positives. It measures how many actual positive cases the model detects.

title: Imbalanced classification
text: Accuracy can hide poor minority class performance in imbalanced classification. Inspect precision, recall and a confusion matrix, and select metrics based on the costs of errors.

title: Overfitting
text: Overfitting happens when a model learns training-specific patterns that fail to generalize. A gap between strong training performance and weak validation performance can signal overfitting.

title: Cross validation
text: Cross validation repeats fitting and evaluation across different training and validation folds. Group-related observations must stay in the same fold to avoid information leakage.

title: Time series evaluation
text: Time series evaluation trains on earlier observations and evaluates on later observations. Random splits can reveal future information and produce optimistic results.

title: Retrieval augmented generation
text: Retrieval augmented generation retrieves source passages before generating an answer. Retrieved evidence can be irrelevant, and generated answers still require evaluation for correctness and source support.

title: Abstention
text: Abstention means declining to answer when evidence is insufficient. Increasing an abstention threshold can reduce coverage while improving accuracy among answered questions.

title: Baseline models
text: A baseline model provides a simple reference for comparison. More complex models should be compared against the baseline using the same evaluation data and metrics.

title: Causation and correlation
text: Correlation measures association and does not by itself establish causation. Confounding variables can influence both the proposed cause and the observed outcome.
